title.zh: 动物收容与寄养行政专员

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Maintain intake records that distinguish reported information from verified checks.
requirements.zh: 维护接收记录，区分报称信息与已核实查验。

requirements.en: Coordinate approved foster handovers and protect personal contact information.
requirements.zh: 协调获批寄养交接，并保护个人联系信息。

requirements.en: Route animal-health questions to veterinary staff without providing clinical advice.
requirements.zh: 将动物健康问题转交兽医人员，不提供临床建议。
主持有组织的寄养志愿者说明会。

requirements.en: Be available for rotating Sunday daytime shifts.
requirements.zh: 可轮值星期日日间班次。
